candidates.hypothesis: Replace repeated autoregressive confirmation of a stable SPORK candidate by target token verification, while using ETA tool readiness and independently generating the final action. Test whether cheaper confirmation improves the ETA speed-quality tradeoff.
candidates.inputs: Only committed history, tools, visible current reasoning prefix and an already generated candidate.
candidates.labels: None for the first prototype. Original Actor action is used only for after-run evaluation.
candidates.output: Continue reasoning or close reasoning; then canonical model action.
candidates.boundary: Approximate early-exit method, not strict full-Actor trajectory preservation.
controls: candidate verification without exit if needed to isolate overhead

candidates.hypothesis: Use ToolSpec-style schema/history drafts to accelerate confirmation probes themselves, using exact Target verification and current argument values.
candidates.boundary: Expected to preserve each probe distribution; early-exit component still changes Actor behavior.
candidates.labels: Previous committed calls and current generated candidate only; no held-out future trajectories.

candidates.hypothesis: Use memory-retrieved tool-output candidates to start the next Actor call during tool waits, retaining work only on exact observation and compatible-state match.
candidates.boundary: Explore later on a tool-latency-dominated workload; current tau2 tool floor provides limited extra overlap.

prior_evidence.filter: normal completed train timing_spork records only
prior_evidence.interpretation: Retrospective opportunity upper bound; no claim that all slack can be removed.

screening.sample_rule: lowest numeric task IDs from the existing training split, balanced airline/retail; retain failures and regressions
screening.preflight: 2 first-turn prefixes, 2 counterbalanced repeats and negative candidate controls; no tools execute
screening.online_smoke: paired live runs, common runtime, identical starting state; record all model/tool time, final calls, state hashes, D3 accounting and failures
screening.success_requires: Positive measured total wall-time gain, no smoke action/state regression, and mechanism instrumentation confirming the proposed path actually ran. Small samples do not establish non-inferiority or publication value.
screening.held_out_test: Not used for choosing code, thresholds or candidates.
